stops.title: Signing in
stops.caption: One account, whichever way you sign in.
stops.speech: Kairos opens on the sign-in page. You can use an email address and password, or Google, Microsoft or Apple.

stops.title: Your overview
stops.caption: Everything scoped to what you are responsible for.
stops.speech: The overview shows only what your role covers. A fellowship leader sees their fellowship; a pastor sees their branch.
